```{r Pre-setting_plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

standard_tema <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", 
                              size = rel(1.2), 
                              color = "#333333"), 
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", 
                                 size = rel(0.95), 
                                 color = "#555555"), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = rel(0.9)), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = rel(0.85)), 
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Set as global standard-theme
theme_set(standard_tema)
```

This R Markdown is based upon the guideline of the github-website https://anhoej.github.io/qicharts2/articles/qicharts2.html. 

------------------

Firstly, I need to run the R packages `qicharts2 and lock a random number generator to make examples reproducible

```{r package,, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(qicharts2)

# Number generator
set.seed(19)
```

The first run trough is going to be based upon a generated number (n = 24) for a normal distribution - this is saved in a objected call
```{r}
y <- rnorm(24)
```


```{r}
p <- qic(y)
p + labs(
    title    = "Run chart",
    subtitle = "Based on a generated number (n = 24)" 
  )
```
